criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name the load-bearing claim (AI replicating human facilitator) and immediately signal the correction (law school that does not exist) with zero snark. Well under the 210-char LinkedIn cutoff and stands alone as a complete hook.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Claim is genuinely load-bearing (active procurement, late-January 2026 launch, federal grant positioning). Correction names concrete audience (court procurement officers, govtech vendors, federal grant writers) and sector (access-to-justice AI). Drops one point because no dollar amount or contract number is cited; the consequence is real but the financial magnitude is unquantified.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Paragraph 3 is a generous, structurally accurate steelman: 7,000 litigants, state-larger-than-Texas geography, no law school, thin legal aid, and explicitly says the ambition is sound and aimed at the right north star before any rebuttal. A believer in the claim would feel fairly represented. Matches dossier steelman text.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Two rebuttal pillars: (1) Marz's own walk-back quote, invented law school hallucination, 91-to-16 test set cut, 18-month project overrun, all primary source (NBC News, in dossier). (2) Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence April 2025 peer-reviewed paper, multi-institution (Stanford, ANTHC, UAF, Southcentral Foundation, Maniilaq), PMC-indexed, primary. Both entries present in claim_dossier.json counter_evidence.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics appear in nearly every sentence: Stacey Marz, NBC News, AVA, 7,000 litigants, state larger than Texas, no law school, 91 to 16, three-month project, 18 months past target, April 2025, Stanford/ANTHC/UAF/Southcentral Foundation/Maniilaq, 0.2 percent, more than 1,000 papers. One connective sentence in paragraph 4 is purely analytical with no named fact, preventing a 10.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim attribution traces to a primary source (Marz directly quoted in NBC News). Both counter-evidence entries are primary: the same NBC News article and a peer-reviewed Frontiers in AI paper on PMC. All sourcing traces to claim_dossier.json.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical and position-taking throughout. Business-literate without influencer cadence. Corrective without contempt. One minor formulaic phrase is slightly newsletter-template but does not break character.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Paragraphs are 2 to 4 sentences. Word count within 350 to 475 range. Total character count well under 3,000. No wall-of-text. Scans cleanly on mobile and desktop.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closing question is real and debatable and tied directly to the corrected frame of augmentation versus replication. No rhetorical softener, no CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Final paragraph names exactly who should act and what to do: court procurement officers, govtech vendors, and federal grant writers should re-price the reliability gap before the next launch.

hard_fail_checks.name: hashtag_count_in_range
hard_fail_checks.detail: 5 hashtags on closing line. No inline hashtags. Count within 3 to 5.

hard_fail_checks.name: punctuation_bans_held
hard_fail_checks.detail: No em-dashes, en-dashes, double-hyphens, colons, or semicolons in the body.

hard_fail_checks.name: total_char_count_under_linkedin_cap
hard_fail_checks.detail: Total post length 2887 characters, under the 3000 cap.

hard_fail_checks.name: claim_is_attributed
hard_fail_checks.detail: Names Stacey Marz and quotes the claim verbatim, matching claim_dossier.json selected_claim.asserters.

hard_fail_checks.name: steelman_present
hard_fail_checks.detail: Paragraph 3 provides a genuine steelman before any rebuttal, consistent with the dossier.

one_sentence_fix: Add a dollar figure or contract vehicle to give the Alaska procurement consequence a concrete financial magnitude and push this criterion to a 10.
